gloss: to be granted, to be blessed with

definitions.gloss: to be granted, to be given, to receive (from a superior or from heaven)
definitions.explanation: To receive something valuable from a person of higher status, or from a divine or fate-like source. Implies gratitude and humility.
To be blessed with a child. A respectful and joyful way to express the birth or conception of a child.

examples.japanese: {師匠|ししょう}から{教|おし}えを{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: I received teachings from my master.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}から{授|さず}かった{才能|さいのう}を{活|い}かす。
examples.english: To make use of a talent granted by heaven.

examples.japanese: {王|おう}から{名誉|めいよ}ある{称号|しょうごう}を{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: He was granted an honorable title by the king.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: We were blessed with a child.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}して{三年目|さんねんめ}にようやく{子供|こども}を{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: Three years after getting married, we were finally blessed with a child.

examples.japanese: {待望|たいぼう}の{赤|あか}ちゃんを{授|さず}かって、{家族|かぞく}みんなが{喜|よろこ}んでいる。
examples.english: The whole family is overjoyed at being blessed with the long-awaited baby.

notes:
{授|さず}かる is the receiving counterpart of {授|さず}ける (to grant, to bestow). It implies receiving something precious with humility and gratitude.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Counterpart: {授|さず}ける (to grant, to bestow — the giving side)

PATTERN:
- 〜から〜を{授|さず}かる: to receive ~ from ~
- {子供|こども}を{授|さず}かる: to be blessed with a child

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命|いのち}を{授|さず}かる: to be given life
- {教|おし}えを{授|さず}かる: to receive teachings
- {才能|さいのう}を{授|さず}かる: to be blessed with talent
- {子宝|こだから}に{授|さず}かる: to be blessed with children

NOTE: {子供|こども}を{授|さず}かる is the most common everyday use of this word. It is a respectful, warm way to announce a pregnancy or birth.
